subject.title: feat(agent): preserve interrupted-turn context and anchor session recall on search hits

question: Should OpenClaw adopt both durable interrupted-turn transcript markers and pagination-less anchored chat.history reads as core contracts in this combined PR?
rationale: Both are new user-facing agent/session behaviors with durable state and protocol implications, and the protected maintainer label indicates that implementation quality alone cannot establish the intended permanent contracts.

options.title: Split and calibrate
options.body: Separate the interruption marker and anchored-history API into focused PRs so each contract, proof path, and compatibility boundary can be approved independently.

options.title: Keep the combined design
options.body: Approve both contracts together after adding real runtime proof, documenting anchored response semantics, rebasing, and clearing the final checks.

options.title: Narrow to one feature
options.body: Select the higher-priority capability now and leave the other linked issue open for separate product consideration.

recommendation.title: Split and calibrate
recommendation.body: Separate the interruption marker and anchored-history API into focused PRs so each contract, proof path, and compatibility boundary can be approved independently.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the adjacent chat.history paging and transcript-reader design, providing the strongest current-main routing signal for this combined session contract decision.
